fixed_snapshot.mapping_qualification: These five host addresses are fixed experimental mapping hypotheses. They are not independently identified by the SiMa host name list, and nearby corroborated addresses do not establish a global ARC/host alias.
fixed_snapshot.access_qualification: 16-bit loads only. Unknown clear-on-read or other side effects are not ruled out. SRAM fault record and UART progress make the attempted address observable.
fixed_snapshot.interpretation: Success means the fixed observation completed with held-state guards unchanged. Any five values, including all0 or allffff, are retained raw and do not prove readiness, completion, reset isolation or LP4 command functionality.
fixed_snapshot.validation: ASan/UBSan PASS; independent five-address test fixture; 157 UART failures; 152 pre/post guard drift positions; clock high-bit stability; zero/ffff raw values; explicit command-RAM and write rejection; ARM no undefined symbols; no unaligned access
fixed_snapshot.independent_review: spl_early independently checked source, linker/report/fault/stack bounds, builder input/output hashes, and recompiled/reran the final ASan/UBSan native suite in a separate temporary directory; PASS

smallest_command_feasibility.NOP_or_deselect: A zero descriptor is source-authorable, but not established as a no-command operation. Opcode7/39 yield CA0 in the public source; opcode0 is not NOP. d6/d7, mode bits and LP4 CS timing remain unspecified. Do not run the zero descriptor under the name safe LP4 NOP.
smallest_command_feasibility.CKE: Not determined by the JEDEC CA encoder. No evidence identifies d7 as CKE; direct HWT ownership and fields remain separate work.
smallest_command_feasibility.MRW: Four LP4 rising-edge CA/CS values are available. Packing each into repeated phases, or packing two consecutive rising-edge values into d3/d4, are distinct hypotheses. Public LP5 descriptors do not decide between them.
smallest_command_feasibility.MRR: Request encoding is available. A complete transaction also needs fresh receive-valid, lane routing and capture extraction. RxEn/RxVal/Rdcs pulse names do not provide the receive-data interface.
smallest_command_feasibility.fresh_completion: A future experiment can require initial Done0, launch1 and a newly observed nonzero Done before writing launch0, without inventing a status-clear write. That is an experimental acceptance criterion, not a proven register contract or abort mechanism.
smallest_command_feasibility.reset_isolation: MemResetL2 has ProtectMemReset/Value naming and an independent avoid-glitch usage. No established priority table proves it isolates RESET_n from unknown ACSM outputs. Raw engine execution would require explicitly accepting that unresolved output experiment and a board reset recovery path; this snapshot neither performs nor authorizes it.

next_concrete_step: Run only the fixed control snapshot from the already-held SRAM checkpoint. Use actual launch/status/start/stop/timing values to select a bounded control-CSR experiment; do not infer missing LP4 slot or capture semantics from an all-zero readback.
